text:
Alex G.: heads up — saw 6 node evictions in us-west-2-gpu yesterday during a spot rebalance. cluster-autoscaler bounced nodes but several pods got stuck in Terminating for 10+m. we should adjust drain hooks and scale-down windows for preemptible pools.

Priya A.: ugh. any logs? terminating pods are usually stuck on CSI unmount or long preStop.

Alex G.: logs show csi-attacher waiting and our preStop running checkpoint.sh which waits on S3. also CA is set to `--scale-down-unneeded-time=10m` right now. that seems low for GPU workloads.

Marco L.: we set it low to save $$, but with long-running GPU jobs we need a longer cooldown. proposal: increase to 20m for gpu-preemptible pools, and set `--scale-down-utilization-threshold=0.3` for those groups. add node annotation `redwood.io/scale-protected=true` for critical-kernel jobs so CA skips aggressive balancing.

Samira K.: sounds reasonable. also consider adding a pre-delete drain hook to signal checkpoint processes to accelerate shutdown, rather than waiting full grace. we can add a sidecar that listens for `SIGTERM` and triggers `checkpoint --fast`.

Alex G.: rough helm values for cluster-autoscaler i'm thinking to push: 
```
replicaCount: 2
extraArgs:
  scale-down-unneeded-time: "20m"
  scale-down-utilization-threshold: "0.3"
  balance-similar-node-groups: "true"
  skip-nodes-with-system-pods: "false"
nodeSelector:
  lifecycle: preemptible
```

Priya A.: terraform snippet for node pool changes (GKE example):
```
resource "google_container_node_pool" "preempt_gpu" {
  name = "preemptible-gpu"
  autoscaling {
    min_node_count = 1
    max_node_count = 20  # tentative, recommend lowering
  }
  node_config {
    preemptible = true
    metadata = { "node-pool-type" = "gpu-preemptible" }
  }
}
```

Marco L.: don't go to 20 for max — too bursty. suggest max=12 for now and tune after canary. also add taints `gpu-only=true:NoSchedule` and a toleration for batch GPU jobs.

ops-bot: NOTICE: creating infra PR template for staged rollout -> https://git.redwood/infra/pulls/1357 (RED-4321 tracked).

deploy-bot: canary deploy in staging scheduled for Mon 03:00 UTC. will run smoke and eviction-simulation.

Samira K.: one more idea — add a small "buffer" node pool (no GPUs) in us-west-2 with min=3 that CA cannot scale down below 3. it soaks OS-level churn and reduces cold-start latency for non-GPU control-plane pods. Terraform change would create `buffer-pool` with `min_node_count = 3`.

Alex G.: TL;DR plan: 1) bump CA flags in helm chart for preemptible pools, 2) terraform: set preempt_gpu max=12 and add buffer pool min=3, 3) implement preStop/sidecar drain-hooks to speed checkpoints, 4) annotate critical pods with `redwood.io/scale-protected=true`, 5) canary deploy to staging and run eviction tests. i'll open the PR with diffs + risk matrix.

Priya A.: assigning to infra-ops, please include changelog, rollback steps, and expected cost delta.

Marco L.: +1. add PDB checks and make sure we don't violate PodDisruptionBudgets during canary.

Samira K.: i'll pair on PR review and run the eviction sim locally.

Alex G.: thanks all — will ping when PR is ready. @Samira K. remember the CSI unmount workaround in the runbook. :thumbsup:
